entry.title: Vavra 1.0.0
entry.summary: # Vavra 1.0.0 Vavra gets a new native MPC screen in the look of the microQ's front panel, in three skins, with RANDOM and named favourites. ## What's new - **MAIN like the microQ's front**: the keys in a panel over the green LCD (bank and sound with step arrows, status and DSP load), the red data dial that steps through the sounds, eight big performance knobs, and Volume / Output Gain. - **Three skins**: the yellow **microQ**, the **Dark Blue** microQ and the **Phoenix Edition**. entry.title: Vavra 0.1.0
entry.summary: First release of **Vavra for MPC**: gearmulator's Waldorf microQ emulation as a plugin instrument for MPC Gen2 standalones (MPC OS 3.10+). - The original microQ OS 2.23 on emulated hardware, ~45% of one core on an MPC Live III - 300 ROM sounds (banks A-C) plus your own sound-set files (`VST/vavra/banks/`) - Favourites in MPC's PRESET menu; the microQ's LCD live on MAIN - 15 editor pages incl. the modulation matrix, both effects and the 16-step arp pattern - Arpeggiator and clocked LFOs follow MP
